title: Choose Quietroot's urban-garden look
question: The draw picked Riso Seed Zine. Keep it, take an alternate, or draw again.

options.label: Riso Seed Zine
options.lineage: Guerrilla-gardening zines and seed-bomb flyers, printed two-ink on a risograph
options.thesis: Your day printed as a two-ink street-garden zine: green for what grows, pink for what you did today.
options.viewport: Masthead with the date, a two-ink garden print, one lit next action, the rest set quiet below, square tab bar.
options.risk: Fluorescent pink can feel loud to sensory-sensitive users unless it is kept to one mark per screen.

raised.raise: Hierarchy by scale alone: one big condensed word or number per screen, everything else small.
Hairline 1px rules and square corners carry the grid; no soft shadows or glass.
Only the one next action is lit; every other choice on home sits dimmed until touched.
Plant size follows a fixed ramp by how long the activity took, so the garden reads as a record.
Today shows a visible capacity: a gentle day holds about five steps, and the bar says when it is full.

options.label: Community Garden Plots
options.lineage: City community gardens: numbered raised beds, stencilled plot signs, chain-link and asphalt
options.thesis: Your garden is a city lot of numbered raised beds; every activity tends its own plot.
options.viewport: Top-down plot map of numbered beds, a stencilled plot label, one next action, tab bar.
options.risk: The most literal reading of urban garden; stencil type turns gimmicky if used beyond labels.

options.label: Garden Line
options.thesis: Your day as a transit line: each step a station, the next stop lit.
options.viewport: One vertical line of today's steps as stations, the next stop glowing, transfers to Focus and Breathe.
options.case: Strongly urban and makes Today very clear, but the garden disappears, so it loses on identity.
options.risk: Reads as a commuting app; the garden and calm become secondary.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: A giant glyph morphing on a slider.
options.viewport: One huge letter and an axis slider.
options.case: No garden, no city; users do not identify with type tools.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: Every screen a printed plate with registration marks.
options.case: Gallery-like and detached from daily struggle.
options.kept: Hairline grid discipline and square corners.

options.label: Title Wall
options.thesis: Rows of tiles; the focused one grows.
options.case: Endless rows are the opposite of calm, low-choice design.
options.kept: Only the focused item is lit; the rest dims.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Progress as stars ranked by size.
options.viewport: A night chart of completed sessions.
options.case: Beautiful at night but neither urban nor a garden.
options.kept: Importance carried by size on a fixed ramp.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.thesis: The day as a mixtape with side A and B.
options.case: Charming but nostalgic and unrelated to gardens.
options.kept: A hard, visible capacity you fill but cannot overflow.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A calm wellness app as most ship it, done very well.
canonCard.viewport: Greeting, a large rounded card for today's suggestion, a grid of activity cards.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other calm app; no urban garden character.
